controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Stooke’s Viking and MRO mosaic. Large areas have only coarse observations; source shading, seams and polar interpolation remain. The source supplies no validity mask.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radius above a 6.2 km reference sphere, sampled from the Ernst et al. (2023) shape model. Facets without a solved SPC albedo are conservatively withheld; the full shape includes less-constrained terrain.
controls.title: Radius above a 6.2 km reference sphere, sampled from the Ernst et al. (2023) shape model. Facets without a solved SPC albedo are conservatively withheld; the full shape includes less-constrained terrain.

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Relative brightness solved jointly with shape from mission images; this is the released SPC scale, not a natural-color photograph or a calibrated absolute albedo. Grid marks facets without solved albedo support; this is a conservative mask, not a complete image-coverage measurement.

controls.label: Slope
controls.description: Slope relative to modeled gravity, using uniform density, rotation and Mars at the mean orbital distance. Values come from the released facet table. Grid marks facets without solved albedo support; this is a conservative mask, not a complete image-coverage measurement.
